title: Complete Web Development Bootcamp
description: Learn full-stack web development from scratch. This comprehensive course covers HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. By the end, you will be able to build and deploy complete web applications with confidence.

title: UI/UX Design Masterclass
description: Design beautiful and user-friendly interfaces with Figma and design thinking principles. This course covers wireframing, prototyping, color theory, typography, and usability testing to help you create stunning digital experiences.

title: Python for Data Science
description: Master Python programming, Pandas, NumPy, and data visualization techniques using Matplotlib and Seaborn. You will learn how to analyze real-world datasets, build insightful charts, and extract meaningful patterns from raw data.

title: Advanced React & Next.js
description: Build production-ready applications with React and Next.js. This course dives deep into server-side rendering, static site generation, API routes, authentication, performance optimization, and deployment strategies for modern web apps.

title: Digital Marketing Strategy
description: Grow your brand with powerful digital marketing strategies including SEO, Google Ads, social media marketing, email campaigns, and content creation. Learn how to attract, engage, and convert your target audience into loyal customers.

title: Ethical Hacking & Cybersecurity
description: Learn penetration testing, network security, and ethical hacking techniques used by professional security experts. This course covers vulnerability assessment, exploit development, web application security, and how to protect systems from real-world cyber threats.

title: Machine Learning A–Z
description: Hands-on machine learning with Python, scikit-learn, and TensorFlow. This course covers supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, natural language processing, and model deployment. You will build real-world ML projects from start to finish.

title: Graphic Design Fundamentals
description: Master the core principles of graphic design including typography, color theory, layout design, and visual hierarchy. This course will teach you how to create eye-catching logos, posters, and digital graphics using industry-standard design tools.
